Subject: Intro: Discovery + demo for Luminexa (proposed slots, agenda attached)

Hi Asha — great to meet virtually. Thank you for the intro. I’m Ben (AE) on the Redwood side; looping in Sofia (eng ops) and Olga (solutions engineer) so we can align the technical owners for the discovery/demo.

Quick ask: can you confirm who from Luminexa will attend as the product champion and engineering lead? It helps us scope the demo (30 vs 60 minutes) and prepare security evidence upfront.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 23 Aug, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Fri 24 Aug, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Mon 27 Aug, 14:00–15:00 PT

Agenda (draft, attached):
1) 10 min intros & success criteria
2) 30 min demo (focused on inference latency/cost controls)
3) 15 min architecture/security Q&A
4) 5 min next steps / procurement / pilot ask

Attachments: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (draft)

If any procurement or security folks need to see SOC2/retention info before the call, say the word — Olga can attach a short evidence pack.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf

Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Discovery + demo for Luminexa (proposed slots, agenda attached)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear agenda. I’ll be the product champion on this side; Tom Briggs (cc’d) is our engineering lead and should join the technical portion. I’ve also cc’d procurement for timeline/PO questions.

Our preference is a 60-minute session so Tom has time for architecture Q&A. The 27 Aug slot at 14:00 PT works best for the team. Can you confirm duration and whether you require any network access or sample payloads ahead of time?

Also — security asks before we meet: we need a short SOC2 evidence summary and confirmation of data residency (we keep production in us-west). If you can drop an evidence checklist it’ll speed procurement. I’ve attached our attendee list and a short note on compliance reviewers.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Head of Product, Luminexa

Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Discovery + demo for Luminexa (technical pre-reqs + evidence)

Hi Asha and Tom — Olga here, Solutions Engineering. Thanks for confirming the 27 Aug slot; 60 minutes is perfect. A couple of quick technical items so we can make the session productive:  

Pre-demo ask (small):
- If you can share one representative input payload (anonymized) and expected QPS for a pilot, we’ll tailor caching/batching examples.
- Network: demo will be cloud-hosted; we don’t need VPN or private peering for the discovery, but if you expect to test internal-only models later we can discuss VPC options in the follow-up.
- Security evidence: I’m attaching a short SOC2 evidence request spreadsheet — it lists the most common docs procurement asks for (policies, audit report summaries, retention policy). We’ll provide redacted items where appropriate.

Logistics: I’ll present the inference runtime overview and walk through a short live run of a 512-token request (approx 200ms 95th percentile on our baseline). If Tom can share a sample model architecture or tokenization profile that would help — otherwise we’ll use a representative open model.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
